opa1k_pvt16.title: 16,000 Scattered Op-Amp PVT Tasks (1k × 16)
opa1k_pvt16.description: 1,000 distinct post-PEX GF180 op-amp designs (12 topologies, 1.8V/3.3V, 200fF/2pF, 50nA-500uA) x 16 PVT corners = 16,000 small scattered OP + AC + 10mV step Tran tasks in one single run (~10 min on stock ngspice-47 Sparse 1c).

sar12_hero_16cyc.title: 12-bit SAR ADC (16 Cycles, Hero)
sar12_hero_16cyc.description: 12-bit redundant post-PEX SAR ADC sampling a continuous 151.5 kHz sinewave over 16 full conversion cycles (>10 min on stock ngspice-47 Sparse 1c). Verified bit-exact on all 16 output codes (r=0.9999997).

sar12_probe_2cyc.title: 12-bit SAR ADC (2 Cycles)
sar12_probe_2cyc.description: 2-cycle probe of the 12-bit post-PEX redundant SAR ADC on a continuous 151.5 kHz sinewave.

ti12_full_300ns.title: Full-Chip 3-ch TI 12b SAR + PLL (300 ns)
ti12_full_300ns.description: 7,221-equation post-PEX full-chip time-interleaved 12-bit ADC + PLL over 300 ns (17.6k Newton iterations).

pll_ring_150m_4us.title: 150 MHz Wide-Tuning Ring PLL Startup (4 µs)
pll_ring_150m_4us.description: Closed-loop Type-II charge-pump 7-stage ring PLL (3.3x wide tuning range: 65.8-218.6 MHz) starting from code 0, converging via 6-bit SAR AFC to half full-scale code 31, and phase-locking at 152.7 MHz.

sdm16_120cyc.title: 16-bit Switched-Cap SDM (120 Cycles)
sdm16_120cyc.description: Post-PEX 16-bit switched-capacitor CIFB sigma-delta modulator with non-overlapping clocks and SC-CMFB over 37.5 µs (120 clock cycles, ±0.80 V diff in-band sine, bit-exact on all 115 PDM bits, ideal-DAC + Sinc3 recovery r=0.9993).
